name: automattic/wpcom-legacy-redirector
description: WordPress plugin for handling large volumes of legacy redirects in a scalable manner.

scripts.seed: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") wp eval-file bin/seed-dev-data.php
scripts.test:integration: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist
scripts.test:integration-coverage: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") /bin/bash -c 'XDEBUG_MODE=coverage ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist --coverage-text=/dev/null'
scripts.test:integration-ms: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") /bin/bash -c 'WP_MULTISITE=1 ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist'
scripts.test:integration-ms-coverage: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") /bin/bash -c 'WP_MULTISITE=1 XDEBUG_MODE=coverage ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist --coverage-text=/dev/null'

scripts-descriptions.coverage: Run tests with code coverage reporting
scripts-descriptions.coverage-ci: Run tests with code coverage reporting and send results to stdout
scripts-descriptions.cs-fix: Run PHP Code Sniffer and fix violations
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Generate a POT file for translation
scripts-descriptions.lint-ci: Run PHP linting and send results to stdout
scripts-descriptions.seed: Seed the wp-env dev site with redirect edge cases (pass a number for extra bulk rows)
scripts-descriptions.test:integration-coverage: Run integration tests with a coverage driver so strict coverage annotations are enforced
scripts-descriptions.test:integration-ms: Run integration tests in multisite mode
scripts-descriptions.test:integration-ms-coverage: Run multisite integration tests with a coverage driver so strict coverage annotations are enforced
